title: Grace, Soft Landing and Status Match Terms by Wanderlane Traveller Club Tier
content:
Five figures are recorded against a Wanderlane Traveller Club tier for the terms that follow a review. The grace figure is the calendar months of grace after a failed review before the tier actually drops. Soft landing records whether a failed review drops the member only one tier rather than to the level actually earned. Status matching records whether a status held with another programme may be matched into the tier; where it may, the challenge days are the calendar days a matched member has to earn the tier outright and the challenge figure is the qualifying points that must be earned inside the challenge to keep the matched tier.

| Tier | Grace, calendar months | Soft landing | Status match into this tier | Challenge days | Challenge qualifying points |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Wanderlane Blue | 0 | not enabled | not permitted | 0 | 0 |
| Wanderlane Silver | 1 | not enabled | permitted | 90 | 6000 |
| Wanderlane Gold | 2 | enabled | permitted | 90 | 15000 |
| Wanderlane Platinum | 3 | enabled | permitted | 120 | 30000 |
| Wanderlane Titanium | 3 | enabled | not permitted | 0 | 0 |
| Wanderlane Ambassador | 6 | enabled | not permitted | 0 | 0 |

## Two independent columns

Grace and soft landing do not turn on together. Wanderlane Silver carries 1 month of grace with soft landing not enabled, while Wanderlane Gold carries 2 months of grace with soft landing enabled, and the two highest tiers carry 3 and 6 months respectively with soft landing enabled.

## Where matching is open

Matching is permitted at Wanderlane Silver, Wanderlane Gold and Wanderlane Platinum only, and each of those three carries its own pair of challenge figures: 90 days against 6000 qualifying points at Wanderlane Silver, 90 days against 15000 at Wanderlane Gold, and 120 days against 30000 at Wanderlane Platinum. Wanderlane Blue, Wanderlane Titanium and Wanderlane Ambassador are recorded as not open to matching, and their challenge figures stand at 0 days and 0 qualifying points.
